name: KASTEN 63

specs.notes: 585 PS (430 kW, 577 hp) at 6,000 rpm, 850 N m from 2,500 to 3,500, 0-100 km/h in 4.5 s, 220 km/h limited (240 with the Driver's Package), 2,560 kg kerb, 2,890 mm wheelbase, 1,966 mm tall. 4MATIC splits 40:60; three locking diffs off-road (lightly locked here).

garage.blurb: A brick with a twin-turbo V8. Tall and upright: it rolls, it pitches, it shoves air out of the way, and it goes much faster than a box should.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin (seats, dash, wide screen); steering wheel cut out to turn, lever animated.

source.author: Outlaw Games (Sketchfab listing in the package README); the GLB's own metadata names Ddiaz Design
source.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (README); the GLB's metadata says CC BY 4.0
source.attribution: "2020 Mercedes-Benz G-Class AMG G63" by Outlaw Games (CC BY-NC 4.0); file metadata: "2020 Mercedes-Benz G-Class AMG G 63" by Ddiaz Design (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/2020-mercedes-benz-g-class-amg-g-63-64db1862be754722bbf4f23695bf06a5), CC BY 4.0

limitations: The package README and the GLB's metadata disagree on the author and licence (both credited; the stricter, non-commercial one assumed).
The 9-speed's ratios are approximate (AMG doesn't publish all of them); weight distribution and drag area are estimates.
Mercedes stars remain in its textures (grille, wheels, steering wheel, spare cover).
No live gauges yet (data/dash): its own textured screens, the dome light.
